packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs. A tag is a mutable reference to code that runs with repository credentials. npm packages already carry integrity hashes in the lockfile.
Held on purpose. c12 4 is a release candidate, and typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet. Bump each by hand when that changes.
Majors need a person. An automated major lands a breaking change on a branch nobody chose to upgrade.
One pull request for everything else. Ungrouped updates produce a pull request per dependency and the whole set gets ignored together.
